docs.title: A catalogue of a most elegant and superb collection of pictures : imported by John Bertels of Brussels, and purchased out of the best cabinets abroad, such as De Heer Bubeling, Fiseau, Vander Dussen, and Vandervelde of Amsterdam, and Monsieur le comte de Barre, of Paris.

A catalogue of a capital and well-chosen collection of Italian, French, Flemish, and Dutch pictures, of the late Edward Parker, Esq., dec. : brought from his seat at Brigg, in Lincolnshire : consisting of an assemblage of the works of the esteemed ancient, as well as those of the most admired modern artists, viz. Raphael, Parmegiano, Titian, Guerchino, Petoni, Solimini, Jos. Chari, Zucarelli, Cassali, G. Ochiali, N. Poussin, De La Hire, Boulonge, Rubens, Vandyke, Teniers, Both, P. Neefs, Rotenhamer, Rembrandt, Wouverman, Ruysdael, De Husch, G. Douw, Terborgh, Moucheron, Wilson, Wright, of Derby, Marlow, &c. &c. &c
